text:
maya: Quick sync — planning a small PLG launch sprint next week. Goal: test free-credit gating + a tightly scoped webinar + curated prompt templates to move cohorts from trial -> retained. Can we align on routing, copy, and benchmark narrative? https://go/repo/launch-sprint (PRD draft)
liam: I can join. Key metrics we should lock: activation rate (first 5 requests), 7-day retention, and CPAC. What targets are we aiming for? :chart_with_upwards_trend:
sara: FYI from last cohort: activation 12%, 7d retention 18%, CPAC ~$42. Quick hypothesis: webinar + prompt pack improves activation to ~18% and drops CPAC by ~25%.
devin: I sketched 3 headline variations for the launch post and a short email CTA. Pasting roughs:
- "Ship AI features faster — free credits + ready prompts. Join our quick workshop." 
- "Turn prompts into product: free credits + templates — demo + office hours."
- Email CTA: "Claim your starter credits & join the workshop — reserve a seat"
maya: Nice. We should A/B the CTAs (workshop vs templates-first). Also want a one-line benchmark claim for the launch post that ties to developer outcomes (latency/cost + predictability). liam can we make it defensible?
liam: Yep. I'll work with sara to pick numbers we can publicly cite. Prefer phrasing like: "Customers cut inference unit cost up to X% with Redwood Optimize" — but only if data supports.
sara: I'm pulling a quick table — ab test cohorts from Jan: median inference cost per session and 95th latency. Will drop snapshot in the doc. Link: https://go/data/benchmarks/launch-jan
maya: Routing proposal (very small rule set to start):
```
if first_7_days.requests >= 5 and first_7_days.tokens > 300:
  route -> "power-user-webinar-invite"
  send -> "credits+templates" email
else:
  route -> "nurture-credit-drip"
  send -> "starter-prompts" email
```
maya: This keeps early heavy users in the webinar funnel and others in a prompt-driven nurture. We can tune thresholds after 48h.
devin: For the webinar landing — short bullets we should highlight: 1) how to reduce per-token cost with caching/batching 2) prompt templates for shipping 3) live Q&A. Draft hero copy: "Ship reliable LLM features — free credits + practical prompts."
ben: I'll own the webinar landing + registration flow. Can we confirm the cadence? 45m + 15m office hours within 48h of credit grant?
maya: Yes. 45m demo + 15m office hours. @ops-bot can you schedule the post for Tuesday morning and add the webinar block to the event calendar?
ops-bot: Scheduled social post to go live at 2412350000. Webinar event created: "PLG Starter Sprint — prompts & credits" (2412353600)
liam: One more ask — add a GA funnel event for "first_prompt_sent" and a segment for "webinar_invite_sent" so we can track incremental lift. I'll set that up before launch.
sara: I'll run a small A/B split on the onboarding flow (prompt-pack vs workshop-first) and return a 48h readout. Goal: +/- 4ppt in activation.
maya: Tasks: @devin finalize copy variations (post + email) by EOD Thu, @liam set events & segments, @sara run split and share results, @ben build landing. We'll reconvene Fri 11am to lock the benchmark paragraph. :thumbsup:
devin: Ack, I'll post copy drafts here when ready.
liam: 👍
sara: Will do.
maya: Thanks team — excited to move fast on this. Keep everything in the doc and I'll pull the final narrative for the launch post on Friday.
